analysis:
The change to scripts/test-darkbloom-route.py is test-only. It updates the pinned upstream watchdog commit reference in a comment (line 132, d6d257c2 replacing 31236c54). It also adds a regression assertion in test_watchdog_rescues_only_this_repositorys_routed_runs (head lines ~949-953). The assertion forbids passing run, job or cancelled listings to jq as `--arg`/`--argjson` arguments, which avoids 'Argument list too long' failures (exit 126).

No runtime provider, coordinator, attestation, encryption or key-handling code is touched, so the provider-facing threat-model assets (A-001, A-003, A-015, A-016, A-018 and others) and the TB-002, TB-011 and TB-012 boundaries are not affected. The pinned commit hash comment is not verified against the actual watchdog workflow file (.github/workflows/darkbloom-watchdog.yml), which is not in the supplied evidence. That file is the real security-relevant artifact for CI availability and for the label-scoped re-run authority. Reviewers should confirm separately that it matches the claimed upstream commit and that the existing assertions (read-only permissions, actions/checks write only, no secrets or checkout) still hold. The new test narrows the regression surface and adds no attack surface. No findings.
